instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a bright winter park with bare trees, the woman with curly hair (R1) wearing a black puffer jacket, a thick gray scarf, and gray fingerless gloves stands on the left, smiling warmly. The man in the gray beanie (R2) wearing a plaid jacket with a fleece collar stands behind her to the right, smiling down affectionately. He wraps his arm around her chest in a cozy embrace, while she holds his gloved hand. Bright natural sunlight backlights the couple, creating a warm, soft winter atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
